name: ai.zendiq/mcp
title: ZendIQ
description: Solana swap safety for agents: free token screen, $0.01 swap verdict, $0.02 built swap via x402.

environmentVariables.name: ZENDIQ_AGENT_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Payment network: mainnet (default) or devnet. The free screen tool needs no payment.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder holding payer-mainnet.key.json (any file solana-keygen writes) and the budget ledger. Defaults to ~/.zendiq. Never inside the npm cache.

environmentVariables.name: ZENDIQ_AGENT_BUDGET_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Spend-ceiling ledger every payment is reserved against. Defaults to <state dir>/budget-<network>.json, created by: npx -y @zendiq/mcp budget init 1.00

environmentVariables.name: ZENDIQ_AGENT_KEYPAIR
environmentVariables.description: Devnet only: path to a Solana keypair JSON file holding devnet USDC.
